parameters.query:
select
  (select max(id) from an_prod_cbc.chats) as chat,
  (select max(id) from an_prod_cbc.bid_releases) as rel,
  (select max(id) from an_prod_cbc.bids) as bid,
  (select to_char(max(updated), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') from an_prod_cbc.deals) as deals_desde

with
nomes as (
  select distinct on (user_id) user_id, name from an_prod_cbc.user_profiles where not deleted order by user_id, id
),
prod as (
  select p.id, coalesce(nullif(t.pt, ''), p.name) as nome
  from an_prod_types.products p
  left join an_prod_types.product_translations t on t.id = p.translations_id
),
chat_novo as (
  select 'chat'::text as tipo, c.id as ref_id, to_char(c.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') as ts,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'produto', (select nome from prod where id = b.product_id),
      'bid_id', bu.bid_id,
      'interessado', jsonb_build_object('id', ci.id, 'nome', ci.nome, 'email', ci.email, 'telefone', ci.telefone),
      'anunciante', jsonb_build_object('id', ca.id, 'nome', ca.nome, 'email', ca.email, 'telefone', ca.telefone),
      'quem_enviou', case when c.sender_id = b.creator_id then 'anunciante' else 'interessado' end
    ) as dados
  from an_prod_cbc.chats c
  join an_prod_cbc.bid_users bu on bu.id = c.bid_user_id
  join an_prod_cbc.bids b on b.id = bu.bid_id
  left join lateral (
    select u.id, u.email,
      (select up.name from an_prod_cbc.user_profiles up where up.user_id = u.id and not up.deleted order by up.id limit 1) as nome,
      (select regexp_replace(ph.number, '\D', '', 'g')
         from an_prod_cbc.user_profiles up
         join an_prod_cbc.profile_phones pp on pp.profile_id = up.id
         join an_prod_cbc.phones ph on ph.id = pp.phone_id
         left join an_prod_types.phone_types pt on pt.id = ph.type_id
        where up.user_id = u.id and not ph.deleted
          and length(regexp_replace(ph.number, '\D', '', 'g')) between 10 and 13
        order by (pt.name = 'Celular') desc nulls last, ph.id desc
        limit 1) as telefone
    from an_prod_cbc.users u where u.id = bu.user_id
  ) ci on true
  left join lateral (
    select u.id, u.email,
      (select up.name from an_prod_cbc.user_profiles up where up.user_id = u.id and not up.deleted order by up.id limit 1) as nome,
      (select regexp_replace(ph.number, '\D', '', 'g')
         from an_prod_cbc.user_profiles up
         join an_prod_cbc.profile_phones pp on pp.profile_id = up.id
         join an_prod_cbc.phones ph on ph.id = pp.phone_id
         left join an_prod_types.phone_types pt on pt.id = ph.type_id
        where up.user_id = u.id and not ph.deleted
          and length(regexp_replace(ph.number, '\D', '', 'g')) between 10 and 13
        order by (pt.name = 'Celular') desc nulls last, ph.id desc
        limit 1) as telefone
    from an_prod_cbc.users u where u.id = b.creator_id
  ) ca on true
  where c.id > $1::bigint and not c.deleted
    and not exists (
      select 1 from an_prod_cbc.chats c2
      where c2.bid_user_id = c.bid_user_id and c2.id < c.id and not c2.deleted
    )
),
contato as (
  select 'contato'::text, r.id, to_char(r.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US'),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'produto', (select nome from prod where id = b.product_id),
      'bid_id', r.bid_id,
      'quem', (select name from nomes where user_id = r.user_id),
      'dono', (select name from nomes where user_id = b.creator_id)
    )
  from an_prod_cbc.bid_releases r
  join an_prod_cbc.bids b on b.id = r.bid_id
  where r.id > $2::bigint and r.released and not r.deleted
),
anuncio as (
  select 'anuncio'::text, b.id, to_char(b.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US'),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'produto', (select nome from prod where id = b.product_id),
      'operacao', (select name from an_prod_types.bid_operations where id = b.operation_id),
      'preco', b.price,
      'quantidade', b.quantity,
      'uf', (select uf from an_prod_types.states where id = b.state_id),
      'quem', (select name from nomes where user_id = b.creator_id)
    )
  from an_prod_cbc.bids b
  where b.id > $3::bigint and not b.deleted
),
venda as (
  select 'venda'::text, d.id, to_char(d.updated, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US'),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'produto', (select nome from prod where id = b.product_id),
      'bid_id', d.bid_id,
      'dono', (select name from nomes where user_id = d.bid_owner_id),
      'outra_parte', (select name from nomes where user_id = d.dealer_id),
      'preco', p.price,
      'quantidade', p.quantity
    )
  from an_prod_cbc.deals d
  join an_prod_cbc.bids b on b.id = d.bid_id
  left join an_prod_cbc.deal_proposals p on p.id = d.current_proposal_id
  where d.status_id = 5 and not d.deleted and d.updated >= $4::timestamp
)
select * from chat_novo
union all select * from contato
union all select * from anuncio
union all select * from venda
order by 3, 2

parameters.content:
## AgroNegociar — Notificações do marketplace no grupo
A cada 2 min consulta a réplica (schema an_prod_cbc) e avisa no grupo: **primeiro chat**, **contato liberado**, **anúncio novo** e **venda fechada** (deal status 5).

Cursores ficam no staticData (só persiste com o fluxo ATIVO). Na primeira execução ativa ele só marca o ponto de partida, sem despejar histórico.
Envia pela instância MIA-LOGS (credencial do n8n) para o grupo "Mia e Maya <> AgroNegociar".
Envia pela instância MIA-LOGS (credencial do n8n) para o grupo "Mia e Maya <> AgroNegociar".
No chat novo, a mensagem traz nome, e-mail, telefone e id dos dois usuários, o produto e o anúncio. Não envia o texto das conversas.
